name: Saldor API
description:
The Saldor API powers Saldor's procure-to-pay platform — purchase orders, item receipts, invoices, vendor management, and three-way matching. Every response is enveloped as `{ data, meta? }`; errors as `{ error: { code, message } }`. 

## Authentication

All endpoints require a bearer token. Create an API key in **Settings** at [console.saldor.com](https://console.saldor.com) and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
